## Purpose
The Catalog's Annotations view: every annotation (subject → predicate → concept) as filterable rows, with single and bulk removal.

## Responsibilities
- `AnnotationsTab` reads `ontologyApi.annotations`. `asRows` flattens the response. Removal uses `deleteAnnotation` ("Annotation removed.").
